entries.land_description: This is a small working farm with beef cows, bees, chickens, garden, haycrop and fruit trees/bushes. Visitors with strong backs will not be turned away come haying season (end May, early June)! No drugs, unable to accommodate extended visits. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 20 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, woman living and working on the land.

I am 1 lesbian with a number of cats and dogs living on 60 secluded acres in Virginia's scenic Shenandoah Valley. Small organic vegetable and herb gardens. No hunting or other exploitation of animals; no hard drugs, firearms, or womyn with allergies to cats and/or dogs. I am/have: 1 lesbian, 60 acres, house plus barn & springhouse, plumbing, electricity, woods, small farmland, rough camping space, woman living and working on the land.

We have built one house (not yet finished) and would welcome work exchange for (extended) visits on this house, a new house, and other gardening chores. We are/have: 3 lesbians, 1 girl child (2 yrs), 45 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, electricity in one house, woods, camping space, woman living on the land.

entries.land_description: We are seven Lesbian Separatists, one womoon child and her mother, and two women who want to "sell out." For almost five years we have worked to dis-cover a process of consensual decision making that provides power and integrity for every womoon. We are creating new ways. We ask all radical Lesbian Separatists with earth conscious magical spirits to help us keep this 320 acres a safe and healthy home for wild womyn, plants, and animals. We welcome letters and visits from ALL interested Lesbians and Lesbian loving womyn. We are/have: 9 lesbians, 1 womoon child, 320 acres, housing/permanent structures, renovated barn and sheds, woods, camping space for tents, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: (25 miles from Sante Fe outside quaint town of Madrid, NM). We are located on a gorgeous mesa with a 360 degree view of New Mexico mountains (we've renamed them all). Pinon and juniper, lots of rabbits, coyotes and a snake or two. We offer camping space to sisters traveling alone or with young children and peaceful animals. We have a school bus/home and are building a house the spring of '86. Small voluntary donation requested. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, horses, very few neighbors. We haul water by truck from 5 miles away. We do not use drugs or alcohol and are primarily, though not exclusively, veggies.

entries.land_description: We are a womyn's guest house on Cape Cod, offering large double rooms with morning coffee as well as fully equipped apartments. We are located on a quiet side street and yet close to all the "hot spots" and beaches of Provincetown.
